description: Exhaustive debloat rules for Xiaomi, Redmi, and POCO smartphones running MIUI or HyperOS, targeting ad daemons, tracking telemetry, and duplicate OEM services.

rules.name: MIUI System Ads (MSA Global)
rules.description: Core ad-serving background daemon responsible for displaying popups and banners inside System Apps (Themes, Security, File Manager). Disabling this eliminates most system ads.

rules.name: MIUI Analytics
rules.description: Continuous telemetry service monitoring device behavior, screen time, network usage, and app launches.

rules.name: MIUI Background Daemon
rules.description: Silent diagnostic background daemon periodically uploading device performance and system logs to Xiaomi servers.

rules.name: Joyose Performance Service
rules.description: Aggressive background performance throttling engine. Disabling often improves game frame-rates, reduces stutter, and stops telemetry reports.

rules.name: Mi Pay
rules.description: Proprietary payment service bundled on Xiaomi devices.

rules.name: Mi Pay India Wallet
rules.description: Regional UPI wallet and credit card integration from Xiaomi with promotional notifications.

rules.name: Mi Credit
rules.description: Preloaded instant loan solicitation app sending high-interest credit push ads.

rules.name: Yellow Pages Directory
rules.description: Caller ID service and local vendor ad directory that displays sponsored merchant listings.

rules.name: GetApps (Mi Picks)
rules.description: Xiaomi secondary app marketplace with aggressive daily app recommendations and auto-update prompts.

rules.name: Mi Browser Global
rules.description: Preloaded browser loaded with trending news feeds, clickbait stories, and data collection.

rules.name: Mi Browser (AOSP)
rules.description: MIUI modified default browser with sponsored search bars.

rules.name: Mi Video
rules.description: Bundled video player with heavy online streaming recommendations, short clips, and banner ads.

rules.name: Mi Music
rules.description: Music player loaded with streaming promotions and banner advertisements.

rules.name: Xiaomi Cloud Service
rules.description: Xiaomi proprietary cloud storage backup. Safe to remove if using Google Drive/Photos.

rules.name: Xiaomi Cloud System Package
rules.description: System service package supporting Xiaomi Cloud synchronization.

rules.name: Xiaomi Cloud Backup
rules.description: Scheduled cloud backup agent for photos, contacts, and messages to Mi Cloud.

rules.name: Mi Cloud Sync
rules.description: Sync adapter for gallery, notes, and browser bookmarks to Xiaomi servers.

rules.name: ShareMe (Mi Drop)
rules.description: P2P file transfer client with push ads. Reinstallable from Play Store.

rules.name: Clean Master Engine
rules.description: Third-party Cheetah Mobile cleaner engine bundled inside MIUI Security with ads and background memory scanning.

rules.name: Mi Bug Report
rules.description: Automatic crash log uploader transmitting diagnostic memory dumps.

rules.name: Services and Feedback
rules.description: Feedback collection utility with persistent background logging.

rules.name: Quick Apps
rules.description: Instant mini-app execution engine known for deep tracking and loading sponsored web apps without user confirmation.

rules.name: Quick Apps Accessory
rules.description: Support daemon for Quick Apps runtime.

rules.name: Wallpaper Carousel (Glance for Xiaomi)
rules.description: Dynamic lockscreen wallpapers mixed with promotional news stories and commercial clickbait ads.

rules.name: Mi Weather
rules.description: Pre-installed weather app displaying promotional articles and ads at the bottom of forecasts.

rules.name: Mi Scanner
rules.description: Document and QR code scanner with sponsored shopping search results.

rules.name: Mi Compass
rules.description: Stock digital compass utility. Safe to remove.

rules.name: Mi Notes
rules.description: Default note-taking app. Safe to remove if using Google Keep, Notion, or Obsidian.
